title: Liquid AI opens small multimodal decision models for edge devices
friendlyTitle: Small open AI models make fast decisions on local devices
summary: Liquid AI has released d1-3B and an experimental d1-omni-600M, open models that make structured decisions in a single forward pass rather than generating prose token by token. The models accept combinations of text, images and audio and are designed for low-latency use on edge hardware.
friendlySummary: Liquid AI released two models that can quickly classify information or choose between options. They can work with text, pictures and, in one model, audio.
whyItMatters: Many business workflows need a fast classification, choice or score rather than a conversational answer. Small local decision models can lower latency and cloud cost while keeping more inputs on the device, although the published benchmarks still need independent testing.
friendlyWhyItMatters: These models may help devices make quick decisions without sending every request to the cloud. Independent testing is still important.
